Hektor.et: From Ancient Greek Ἕκτωρ (Héktōr), from ἕκτωρ (héktōr, “holding fast”), from ἔχω (ékhō, “to have, hold”), from Proto-Indo-European *seǵʰ- (“to hold; to overpower”).

hektisch.et: Via Old French from Late Latin hecticus (“febrile”), from Ancient Greek ἑκτικός (hektikós, “habitual”).
